rv.q: It's a disappointment that two actors as gifted as Brody and Thompson should make their Broadway debuts in such a bland, poorly conceived vehicle.

It is said that the wheels of justice turn slowly, but grind exceedingly fine. Fortunately, few of us can claim to have had first-hand experience in testing this adage, especially the "slowly" part.
